description: Close 1 Camofox tab created by this browser task, defaulting to its current tab. Optionally pass a caller-owned tab_id from browser_tabs. Adopted/shared tabs and other tasks' tabs cannot be closed. Success requires server readback confirming the tab is gone. Does not close the browser, account, or other tabs.
name: browser_close

tab_id.description: Optional exact caller-owned tab ID. Omit for the current tab.
